title: Crucible: Evaluating LLM Agents in Executable Chemistry Research Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.34254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on chemistry knowledge benchmarks, which mainly assess question answering and isolated tasks. Chemical research, however, requires using specialized tools and interpreting their outputs to obtain chemically valid results. To address this gap, we introduce Crucible Bench to evaluate this ability across all four stages of the design-make-test-analyze (DMTA) cycle. The benchmark contains 1,078 tasks in 12 task families curated from 18 published datasets, covering molecular design, synthesis planning, experimental execution, closed-loop optimization, simulation, and analytical characterization. Agents access 75 domain-specific tools through the Model Context Protocol in seven isolated environments. Sandboxed graders verify the resulting synthesis routes, experimental protocols, and other outputs. Laboratory tasks use robotic simulators or previously measured experimental data. translated_title: Crucible：在可执行的化学研究环境中评估大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在化学知识基准测试上表现良好，但这些基准主要评估问答和孤立任务。然而，化学研究需要使用专业化工具并解读其输出，才能获得化学上有效的结果。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了Crucible Bench，用于在“设计-制造-测试-分析”（DMTA）循环的全部四个阶段评估这一能力。该基准包含1,078个任务，分为12个任务族，精选自18个已发表的数据集，涵盖分子设计、合成规划、实验执行、闭环优化、模拟以及分析表征。智能体通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）在七个隔离环境中访问75个领域专用工具。沙盒化的评分器会对生成的合成路线、实验方案及其他输出结果进行验证。实验室任务采用机器人模拟器或此前已测得的实验数据。我们将14个大语言模型作为智能体进行评估……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Crucible Bench基准，通过覆盖DMTA循环全部四个阶段的1,078个任务、75个领域专用工具及沙盒化自动评分系统，在可执行的化学研究环境中系统评估大语言模型智能体开展真实化学研究的能力。
